definitions.gloss: to be convinced, to be under the impression
definitions.explanation: To believe something strongly, often without sufficient evidence or despite being incorrect.

definitions.gloss: to assume mistakenly, to jump to conclusions
definitions.explanation: To believe something to be true based on assumptions rather than facts.

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{思|おも}い{込|こ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{思|おも}い{込|こ}んだら、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えない→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、サンタクロース⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{思|おも}い{込|こ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がると→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧{思|おも}い{込|こ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦からだ→から：00504_kara⟧。

examples.english: I had assumed everyone was in agreement, but there were people opposed as well.

notes:
{思|おも}い{込|こ}む is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to be firmly convinced of something.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to go into deeply) → to think deeply and become fixed in belief

ASPECT (ている):
{思|おも}い{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ is the most common form, indicating a state of being convinced or under an impression.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{思|おも}い{込|こ}む (be convinced that~)
- ⟦{思|おも}い{込|こ}み→思い込み：10111_omoikomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ (prone to making assumptions)
- ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{思|おも}い{込|こ}む (assume on one's own)

RELATED NOUN:
- ⟦{思|おも}い{込|こ}み→思い込み：10111_omoikomi⟧: preconception, assumption, belief

USAGE:
Often implies that the belief is mistaken or at least unverified. Used when someone has convinced themselves of something that may not be accurate.
